schema: functions: name -> file, orig, size_orig, status (open, exact), kind, callers, note (by hand: an odd source form, a guessed name, dead code).
compiler: ccv1r (its popt without the v1 switches); libc-v13 (libc-v10 with open 0_1)

main.note: WEGA: files= (ioctl(ibf, 0x6300, files) before skip), chkres after the open/creat messages, the zero count message. The unused label sync: in front of ibc = ibs makes the compiler forget ibc in r2, so ibs goes to r2 as in the original (a forced form).

match.note: exact with the popt of v1r without OLD_D20 (2026-11-24): the loop keeps its test on top.

chkres.note: name guessed; written from the code: stat of the file that failed, perror(ddname) and exit(1) when stat fails, the reserv(1) message for a character device with mode 0. ddname[] = "dd" is a global behind number (the data in front of the strings, as the original), not a literal.

note: libc-v10.a: the open stub differs (ld r2,r5 in ours at 0x1778), not looked into. The "not enough memory" test of System III is gone from the code (pointer < 0 is never true), its string stays.
